events.text: {"verdict":"needs_adi","decision":"Build everything except the vendor-side rotation. 1) Prepare the steps so rotation takes minutes: confirm the app/.env.local variable names (DODO_API_KEY, DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET), the Worker secret name and `wrangler secret put` command for revops-centre, and that probe-workshop.mjs and a signed-test-event script for /hooks/dodo are ready. 2) Do not touch the Dodo dashboard, since creating or rotating credentials is reserved. 3) After Adi supplies the new values, write them to .env.local, set the Worker secret to the live endpoint's own secret, restart the dev server, run probe-workshop.mjs and send a signed test event to /hooks/dodo. Keep T-005 as the last task and do not rotate earlier.","why":"T-005 spec and the owner-launch-constraints rule make Dodo key rotation the final post-launch task. Creating or rotating credentials is reserved for Adi. The launch cohort (7 to 9 Oct) has passed.","outward_ok":[],"reassign_to_claude":false,"adi_input":{"ask":"Open the Dodo dashboard (https://app.dodopayments.com) > Developer > API Keys and regenerate the live key. Then go to Webhooks, open the live /hooks/dodo endpoint (create it if missing) and copy its signing secret. Paste both into app/.env.local as DODO_API_KEY and DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Claude then updates the Worker and runs the probes.","kind":"reserved","why_only_adi":"Owner's written rule reserves Dodo key rotation for after launch, and regenerating live credentials in his account is something only Adi can do."}}
